scope: Audit only; no change to the current 15-degree task, frozen metrics, gates or controller.

current_metric.selection: Selects nine cubelets by immutable actor-name token (default nZ).
current_metric.orientation_reference: Measures each actor orientation relative to Core and the original solved reference; remaining cubelet rotation is measured against that same reference.
current_metric.validity: Suitable for the current first move of the initially named face. Not a general multi-face or formula-execution verifier.
current_metric.position_semantics: position_m is actor/joint-origin position. All 26 joint anchors are at Core, so these positions are not cubie geometric centers. maximum_joint_origin_separation_m intentionally measures anchor consistency.
current_metric.angle_boundary: Arithmetic median of signed angles can become misleading across -180/+180 even when wrapped individual orientation errors are small. Current 15-degree development target is away from that boundary.

future_multiface_requirements_not_implem: Attach a validated geometric cubie-center offset to each original actor using source asset geometry/grid metadata. Transform that local point through the actor pose, then into Core-local coordinates. Do not select layers from actor origins.

Choose the nine members from their current Core-local geometric positions at the start of each move. Validate grid occupancy/assembly and freeze membership for that move; immutable names identify pieces, not their current layer.

Freeze each cubelet's current relative orientation as a per-move reference. Compare selected pieces against the intended face rotation applied to that reference and unselected pieces against their own unchanged reference.
Use sign-invariant SO(3) comparisons plus circular/unwrapped progress for repeated quarter turns and half turns. Do not add native spherical scalar coordinates as if they were portable Euler angles.
Maintain a logical cubie/sticker permutation and orientation state, then connect it to validated visual face/color reconstruction before applying a solving algorithm.
Changing goal references must never add a control-phase cube pose reset, attachment, collision disable, or drive. Physical motion remains produced by the robot contacts.

native_coordinate_limitations.measured: 66 rotational DOFs and exact passive-property readbacks passed. Only hinge DOF0 and first spherical DOF6 received a nonzero initial-velocity probe.
native_coordinate_limitations.mapping: This runtime repeats a spherical joint's USD path for its three DOFs. Preserve actual dof_names and joint_dof_offsets/counts; do not infer distinct axes from unique paths alone.
native_coordinate_limitations.official_semantics: PhysX describes decomposed-quaternion integration for multi-DOF spherical joints. A 90-degree pose is not automatically an Euler gimbal-lock failure. Native scalar coordinates and their wrapping still need finite-angle response validation.
